answer: The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in shale, expire in sparrow, and whisper lists each expiry. Someone running 130 aliases thus needs 45 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2099 identities would post 1995 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
